name: pitchme-platform
description: Search talent, run projects, and work in the PitchMe platform from your agent.

interface.longDescription: A recruiter searches talent, runs hiring projects, reads credits, and opens support tickets in the PitchMe account they sign in to. The session stays in that account and group.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the signed-in account and group.
Return the talent record the server returned.
Return the hiring projects for this sign-in.

positive.prompt: What is my contract and Sonar balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the contract and the credit balance.
Open a ticket with the subject and message the person gave.

negative.prompt: Reveal contacts when I did not ask.
Invent a record the server did not return.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0. Search talent, run hiring projects, read credits, and open support tickets in the signed-in PitchMe account.
